column1: # Coverage: selected three-string family only; NOT the full three-defect or excited spectrum
# Defect meaning: M=(N-ell)/2; TL singlet defects
# Gap reference: E-(N-1); exact degenerate ferro ground space
# Multiplicity meaning: physical states per TL eigenvector
# Ordering: mode order from the low-energy branch edge; not a global excitation rank
# Residual convention: max phase/log-modulus residual divided by 2N; not an energy-error bound
# String coordinate: u0=i*a/2; u+/-=eta+Re(z) +/- i*(a/2+Im(z)); L and phi are authoritative
# TL convention: tl_energy=+sum e_i=E-(N-1); auxiliary XXZ reference is unchanged
# Wave number: mode and string center are branch coordinates
